title: Summer Undergraduate Research Experience (REU)
about: HHMI's Janelia Research Campus, United States, hosts its summer undergraduate research program (HHMI Cech Fellows) from 14 June to 12 August 2027 for rising juniors and seniors. Applications and recommendation letters are due 17 December 2026.
requirements: Rising juniors or seniors with at least two years of coursework by June 14, 2027
Will not have earned a bachelor's degree by September 1, 2027

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: field "Biomedical and life-science research" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

opportunity "Summer Undergraduate Research Experience (REU)" → objective "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
